title: Priscilla McMillan revealed as CIA asset

tellings.quote: Priscilla McMillan who interviewed U Lee when he went to Russia and also befriended Marina Oswald and wrote her autobiography for her. Um she's a CIA agent. She's a witting CIA asset.

plain: Priscilla McMillan, a writer who interviewed Lee Harvey Oswald when he went to Russia, befriended his wife Marina Oswald and wrote Marina's life story for her, was a "witting CIA asset", meaning someone knowingly working for the CIA. A researcher named Jeremy Riss says so on the show, pointing in general to the JFK files without naming a particular document. If true, it would mean the CIA had a person of its own close to the Oswalds from 1959 on.
